mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bt_bot_favor ( favor_id, bot_id, user_id, tenant_id, created_time, status_cd, updated_time, creator_id, updator_id, remark ) VALUES ( #{dto.favorId}, #{dto.botId}, #{dto.userId}, #{dto.tenantId}, , #{dto.statusCd}, , #{dto.creatorId}, #{dto.updatorId}, #{dto.remark} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.favor_id, a.bot_id, a.user_id, b.bot_name, b.bot_use, b.tenant_id FROM bt_bot_favor a JOIN bt_bot b ON a.bot_id = b.bot_id AND a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status_cd = '00A' AND b.status_cd = '00A' AND b.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT bot_id FROM bt_bot_favor WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND user_id = #{userId}
